recap: Thirteen castaways, one tribe, one Tribal Council — that's a merge the way the Survivor gods intended, and we didn't make them earn it, we made them eat for it. Two live grubs, fastest down the hatch, ten seats at the feast: Kristin set her grubs free to the wind, Sharonda and Cristian couldn't chew fast enough, and the rest boarded the boat. Back at camp, Kristin handed Sharonda the Tethered Idol itself — total transparency, big trust. Then came the mess: Mike tried to warn Kristin about a blindside and came in like a mob boss, Kristin confronted Brady, Brady confronted Mike, and Mike lied, lied, lied. "You broke my heart like I was the girl at the prom." Mike wore the individual immunity necklace, which may have saved him. Tribal went live, plans stacked on plans, and when the votes came in, Brady Booker became the first member of our jury.
bullets: A good old-fashioned merge — all 13 at one Tribal, no mergatory, no tiny tribes.
Kristin tossed her grubs to the wind and walked away from the feast; Sharonda and Cristian just couldn't chew.
Kristin didn't just tell Sharonda about the Tethered Idol — she let her hold it.
Mike won immunity, lied to his brody, and got the night's best line thrown right back at him.
Brady is gone on Day 14 — and he's the first vote on our jury.
draftImpact: Taylor, I'm sorry — Brady's out, and you're down to one castaway still breathing, though you still banked 24 to 31. Tim, you are the story tonight: 32 to 48, four for four, and sole possession of first place. Tami, 27 to 39 with three of five still in and Rob not counted under best-4, good enough for second. Austin, 26 to 34. Kylie, 21 to 29. The chase is on.
